visual_action: The video is a montage of clips featuring former Congressman George Santos. It shows him speaking at a podium in Congress, walking through hallways surrounded by press, getting into a car, and speaking on the House floor during his expulsion proceedings. There are also wide shots of the House of Representatives in session, a clip of Mike Johnson speaking, Santos being mobbed by cameras as he leaves a building, and a final shot of a person changing the locks on his former office door.

cast.name: George Santos
cast.evidence: He is the subject of the entire video, shown in multiple clips, and named in the opening on-screen text: 'Remembering George Santos's Career in Congress'.

cast.name: Mike Johnson
cast.evidence: He is shown briefly speaking on the House floor during the montage segment about the vote to expel Santos.

cast.name: U.S. House of Representatives
cast.evidence: The video is set in the House of Representatives chamber and Capitol building, and depicts the formal action of the body voting to expel a member.

on_screen_text.text: Remembering George Santos's Career in Congress (2023-2023) 🙏
✅ Attempted to flee from his constant lies
✅ Investigated for fraud and campaign finance violations
✅ Fighting for his life on the House floor
✅ House voting to expel Santos from the House
✅ Santos running out of the House before he's officially ousted
✅ Locks being changed in Santos's former office

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; a song with a female vocalist plays over the entire clip.
audio_music: A slow, sentimental acoustic ballad with a female vocalist plays throughout the video. The style and lyrics evoke a feeling of graduation or farewell, creating a deliberately ironic and mocking tone for a video about a politician's expulsion for misconduct.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of short clips, with a new text overlay appearing every few seconds to create a checklist of failures. The pacing is steady and follows the rhythm of the song.
cultural_references: The video is structured as a parody of a sentimental 'in memoriam' or graduation tribute montage, a common format used to remember someone's life or time at an institution.
central_claim: George Santos's short and scandal-ridden career in Congress was a complete failure that ended rightfully with his expulsion.
intended_effect: To mock George Santos and encourage viewers to feel satisfaction at his political downfall.
